user.title: Connect to CNAIR eToll
user.description: Enter your eToll account details — the same ones you use in the TollRo app or on portal.etoll.ro. The integration only reads information from your account (vehicles, Ro-vignettes, invoices and notifications); it never makes purchases or changes anything in your account.

data_description.username: The sign-in details you use in the TollRo app.
data_description.password: Your password is stored locally in Home Assistant and is used only to reconnect when the session expires.

reconfigure.title: Update your sign-in details
reconfigure.description: Change the email address (or phone number) or the password the integration uses — for example after you changed your password in the TollRo app or on portal.etoll.ro. The new details are checked before they are saved; your vehicles, entities and history stay exactly as they are.

data_description.username: Leave it as it is if only your password changed.
data_description.password: The password you use now in the TollRo app.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect your eToll account
reauth_confirm.description: Home Assistant can no longer sign in to the account {username}, most likely because the password was changed. Enter your current password — the one you use in the TollRo app — to resume updates.

data_description.password: It is stored locally in Home Assistant and used only to keep the account connected.

error.invalid_auth: Sign-in failed. Check your email address (or phone number) and password — they are the same as in the TollRo app.
error.cannot_connect: The eToll service could not be reached. Check your internet connection and try again in a few minutes; if it keeps happening, CNAIR's servers may be temporarily unavailable.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. Enable debug logging for this integration, try again, then check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This eToll account has already been added to Home Assistant.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Your sign-in details have been updated and the integration has been reloaded.
abort.reauth_successful: Your account is connected again and updates have resumed.
abort.wrong_account: These details belong to a different eToll account than the one configured here. To add another account, set the integration up again as a separate entry.

state.b: B – Freight vehicles up to 3.5 t MAM
state.d: D – Passenger transport, more than 23 seats
state.i: I – Freight vehicles over 3.5 t and up to 7.5 t MAM
state.ii: II – Freight vehicles over 7.5 t and under 12 t MAM
state.iii: III – Freight vehicles of 12 t MAM or more

licenta.title: CNAIR eToll license
licenta.description:
{license_status}

Enter your license key to activate or renew the integration.

data_description.license_key: The key you received by e-mail, formatted ETOLL-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX.

error.license_key_invalid: Invalid license key. Check the format and try again.
error.license_already_used: This license key has already been used on another installation.
error.license_fingerprint_mismatch: This license key is bound to another installation.
error.license_network_error: The license server cannot be reached. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.license_server_error: License server error. Please try again later.

license_expired.description:
